author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring Freelance Artists for Character Design, Sprites, Backgrounds
content: HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS. Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang. Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam: -Character Design & Illustration -Character Sprites -Background & Environment Art -Webtoon / Comic Artwork -Game & Digital Art Assets -Ilustrasi dan visual development lainnya. Kualifikasi: Memiliki portofolio yang kuat... Cara Melamar: kirimkan portofolio dan perkenalan singkat ke: avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com Subject: Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]

author: Sealious Seal
title: LF people who can draw Pokemon (Garchomp, Lucario)
content: LF people who can draw Pokemon. You don’t have to be a Pokemon-centered artist or anything, I just want artists who are willing to draw Pokemon or know how more specifically, Garchomp and Lucario. I usually prefer more anime-esque styles and the OC is cutesy and elegant... place your rates and samples in the comments, NO DMS! MOP: GCash. This is the OC (credit to Miki Fleur) and she will be wearing more fashionable clothes.

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life... These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only... Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST
